generation.prompt:
A pixel-art character reference sheet for a game, redrawing existing characters in a simpler, cleaner style.

Image 1 is the STYLE and SCALE target, the sheet to match exactly: its size of figure, its pixel size, its simple big shapes, its flat clean colour clusters, its readable faces with clear eyes, its clean dark outline, its proportions, its flat dark navy background (#1a2230), its layout. Do not copy its characters.
Image 2 is a second style reference for the simple shapes and the big heads.
The other images are the CHARACTERS to redraw, keeping who they are: hair, face, clothing colours and silhouette, but with far less detail.

Layout: four characters, four views of each side by side, in this order: front, three-quarter front, back, left profile, exactly as in image 1. Plenty of empty background between figures, no figure touching another. No text, no labels, no numbers, no frame. No ground shadow.

Row 1, left: image 3, an old clerk of the tournament: grey hair, short grey beard, a long plain dark blue robe with a thin gold border, holding nothing. Row 1, right: image 4, a veteran master of arms: red hair, short red beard, bright steel armour, a cream fur collar, a plain red cape.
Row 2, left: image 5, a young priestess: long blond hair, a white veil with a blue band, a long ivory and blue dress, no staff. Row 2, right: image 6, a travelling woman armourer: brown hair, a cream headscarf with a red tie, a big leather backpack with bags, an ivory blouse, a dark waistcoat.
Important: plain cloth. NO emblems, NO fleur-de-lis, NO crests, NO symbols, NO embroidery on any clothing, only a thin plain border on capes and robes. Nothing held in the hands unless said. Calm standing pose, arms slightly away from the body so they read clearly. Real pixel art on one regular grid, no blur, no gradient, no dithering.
